patch_description: Combine the best greedy variant (minimize post-placement KVPR, tie-break by more remaining memory) with a candidate-pool approach: build several diverse greedy initial solutions (different sort orders and tie-breaking rules), run local search (move + swap + 3-cycle) from each candidate, and keep the best result. This hedges against a single greedy ordering landing in a poor local basin, as recommended. Runtime is tiny so we can afford multiple restarts. Local-search moves are shared via helper functions to keep the code compact.
